<!--
The three sections below are required. Fill them in and delete these comments as you go --
a template comment left in a posted PR is a defect, not a placeholder.

Title: Conventional Commits, `type(scope): summary`, present-tense imperative.
Types: feat fix docs test refactor chore build ci perf.
No trailing period, no markdown, no internal tracker ID, roughly 70 characters or fewer.
-->

## What

<!--
What changed, in plain sentences with exact nouns -- name the file, the function, the behaviour.
Every claim must be checkable against the diff. What landed, not what you intended or considered.
-->

## Why

<!--
Two things the diff cannot show: why the change is needed, and why this approach over the
alternative a sharp reviewer will ask about. Link the issue it closes: Closes #N
-->

## How I tested it

<!--
The exact commands you ran and the cases they cover. Name what the new tests actually pin --
the boundary, the branch, the guard -- not just "added tests". Say plainly what you did NOT test.
-->

<!--
Optional. Keep either one when it applies; delete it when it does not.

## How to review
Where to start, and the one decision you most want a second opinion on.

## Risk & rollout
Blast radius, how to roll it back, what is deliberately deferred to a follow-up.
-->

## Checklist

<!-- CI builds the site and checks the CSP hashes. These are the things it cannot see. -->

- [ ] Looked at the change in a browser, in both light and dark
- [ ] No personal detail, internal status or private project name in public content
